question: Which of the following animals can change their gender during their life span?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Snail**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Snails** are one of the few animals capable of changing their gender during their lifespan.
 
• This phenomenon is known as **sequential hermaphroditism**, where an organism changes its sex at some point in its life.
